title: Nell's Wobbly Swing
checkpoint: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ie as ee, ea as e, ou as oo.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ie as ee, ea as e, ou as oo.

pages.text: Nell wants a swing on the big oak.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee looking up at a thick branch of a big oak tree, an idea in mind.

pages.text: Nell ties a thin stem to the branch.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee tying a long, thin plant stem around a branch of the oak.

pages.text: Nell sits on the end of the stem.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee perched on the dangling end of the plant stem, ready to swing.

pages.text: The stem snaps. Nell drops down fast!
pages.illustration: The thin stem snapping apart, Nell the bee tumbling toward the ground.

pages.text: Nell lands in the soft grass with a thud.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee landing with a soft bump in a patch of grass below the oak.

pages.text: Nell is not hurt, just a bit cross.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee sitting up in the grass, dusting herself off, looking slightly annoyed.

pages.text: Nell gets a thick twig this time.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee selecting a much thicker, sturdier twig from the ground.

pages.text: Nell ties the thick twig to the branch.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee securely tying the thick twig to the same branch of the oak.

pages.text: This time the swing stays fast.
pages.illustration: The thick twig swing hanging steady and strong from the oak branch.

pages.text: Nell swings and swings. What fun at last!
pages.illustration: Nell the bee swinging happily back and forth on the sturdy twig swing.
